purpose: QA-003: fixed catalog role name plus complete original petId; presentation only

fields.roleName: Catalog character.name looked up by immutable original templateId, independent of mutable appearance/resourceId and stored name.
fields.instanceNumber: Complete original petId, case-sensitive and untruncated. Never regenerate, hash, slice, replace or persist it as another identifier.
fields.historicalNickname: Original stored pet.name when different from roleName; otherwise null. Unknown historical templates use roleName=历史伙伴 and retain their original name here.

invariants: Ownership and every command/selection remain keyed by (ownerAccountId, petId). Display text never selects an instance.
Do not mutate canonical pet.name, pet.serial, templateId, resource, owner, petId, growth, origin, revisions, history or receipts to add this view.
Do not put the projection into SQLite data_json, immutable action results, backup units or cloud envelopes. Their original byte content and checksums remain compatible.
Render roleName and full instanceNumber together; wrap the full number, with no ellipsis or short-prefix substitution.
The same-template twins may share historical serials, names or resources, but their full petIds remain distinct. Equal historical petIds in different owners retain separate namespaces.

adoption.newUi: Submit the selected current template.name; no arbitrary role-name input or rename control.
adoption.legacyCompatibility: Existing stored names and old rename/adoption APIs remain compatible historical data. No cloud migration or server redeployment is required.

coordinatorRouting.request: Use the shared projection for labels and full number while retaining each domain's existing explicit petId and independent selection. This branch intentionally does not edit their UIs or battle core.

uiExample: import { companionIdentity } from "../companions/identity"; const { roleName, instanceNumber, historicalNickname } = companionIdentity(pet);
